previous_statement: Corrected conditional ledger and two independent obstructions. Let e_0>0 be the minimum of e_blk and the universal smallness thresholds in nodes 1.2 and 1.3. If one adds epsilon<=e_0/2 and chooses a_merge=e_0/2, then rho<=a_merge implies e:=rho+epsilon<=e_0. Conditional on nodes 1.1.1, 1.1.2, 1.2, and 1.3, the factorization gamma=alpha_1 Gamma_1 mu_1 makes the raw assembled gamma bijective, gives gamma_n=I_n tensor gamma, gives its unit and multiplicative defects of order e, gives only ||gamma_n(X^dagger)-gamma_n(X)^dagger||<=K_hom*e*||X||, and gives the two-sided (1+-K_norm*e) norm bounds. This does not make gamma_n a delta-homomorphism: the allowed definition requires the exact identity gamma_n(X^dagger)=gamma_n(X)^dagger, and a nonzero O(e) bound does not imply equality when e>0. Hence the raw gamma has not been shown to be an extended inclusion or isomorphism. Child 1.4.1.2 conditionally produces an extended O(e)-isomorphism tilde_gamma by symmetrization, but tilde_gamma need not equal gamma or restrict to the four prescribed corner maps, so it does not repair the raw-assembly conclusion. Independently, the root hypotheses contain no bound on epsilon, so controlling rho alone does not place e below e_0. Thus the allowed inputs do not prove the root contract: a raw-map theorem needs both an epsilon-smallness premise and exact involution compatibility derived or assumed, while the available symmetrization proves only a nearby-map theorem under the added smallness premise.
